title: PremiumAutoStart.request uses RequestId(0) as a 'no request' sentinel
trigger: Subscribe pressed with no driver or no deep-link stage (demo, or the resolve stage already gone): auto_start is stored with RequestId(0)
effect: nothing today (demo only); the stored /start can never be dropped by an error answer and waits for a later visit to the bot
fix: auto_start: Option stage that holds Some(RequestId) only when a resolve went out; no auto_start at all otherwise

title: EditProfileDialog keeps two parallel in-flight stages (op: SectionOp and save: Submit) that must not overlap
trigger: Save pressed while a username/photo op is Sending, or a username op started while save is Sending
effect: each stage settles on its own request; the dialog can show one error while the other stage still waits, and begin_profile_op forgets the earlier op's ack without telling the form
fix: one DialogOp enum (Idle | Section(RequestId) | Saving(Vec<RequestId>)) so only one operation is out at a time
